model.name: Assumption
model.purpose: Represent one governed premise accepted provisionally for a stated purpose, scope and reasoning context without asserting that it is a verified fact.
model.scope_statement: Owns assumption identity and immutable revision; proposition reference or marked statement; kind and epistemic status; proposer, owner, steward, approver, reviewer, challenger and affected roles; purpose, reasoning context, scope, jurisdiction, environment, validity interval and review date; rationale, sources, supporting and contrary evidence; confidence, uncertainty, reliability and sensitivity; typed dependencies and affected outputs; consequences if false, impact, exposure, risk, mitigation and contingency; challenge, validation and review; acceptance, activation, invalidation, expiry, correction, supersession, access, retention and loss-aware projections. Proposition, fact, evidence, hypothesis, requirement, rule, risk, issue, decision, plan, test, measurement and source-document masters remain external.
in_scope: Assumption identity, proposition role, statement, kind, status, revision and authority
Purpose, context, scope, rationale, evidence, uncertainty, dependency, consequence, review and lifecycle
Provenance, governance, access, retention and interoperability
out_of_scope: Owning proposition, fact, evidence, hypothesis, requirement, rule, risk, issue, decision, plan, test, measurement or source-document lifecycles
Equating acceptance with truth, confidence with probability, contextual validation with universal proof, or missing evidence with support
Executing approval, risk acceptance, protected disclosure, external system mutation, safety action or irreversible deletion

boundary_notes.distinction: Claim owns truth-apt proposition identity and content. Assumption owns the premise role, acceptance state and reliance context; the registry parent signal remains under joint boundary review.
A fact or observation is asserted as established under its evidence rules. An assumption is explicitly accepted despite unresolved verification and never becomes a fact through use alone.
A hypothesis is framed for evaluation or testing. An assumption is a premise used by another reasoning or action context and may be testable, untestable or awaiting validation.
Evidence and citations remain external records. The assumption owns qualified support, challenge and gap bindings, not the evidence content.
These records may depend on or challenge an assumption. Their normative force, assessment, treatment and resolution lifecycles remain external.
These contexts rely on assumptions and own accountable choices, execution, algorithms or calculated outputs. The assumption records typed reliance and impact links only.
A validation activity and its evidence remain external. The assumption owns source-qualified assessment links and contextual status, never a global truth flag.

functions.name: Register assumption
functions.description: Create one stable assumption identity linked to a proposition and initial revision.
effects: identity and explicit unknowns are appended

functions.name: Express and classify assumption
functions.description: Record the statement, optional formal expression, assumption kind and epistemic status.

functions.name: Bind context and authority
functions.description: Record purpose, scope, actors, authority, location, validity interval and review date.

functions.name: Accept or sign off assumption
functions.description: Append accountable acceptance for a bounded purpose without asserting universal truth.
effects: prior state and dissent remain visible

functions.name: Link dependencies
functions.description: Bind parent, derived, conflicting and affected requirements, models, estimates, plans and decisions.

functions.name: Assess uncertainty and impact
functions.description: Record confidence basis, sensitivity, false consequences, risk, mitigation and contingency.
effects: confidence, probability and risk remain distinct

functions.name: Challenge assumption
functions.description: Append contrary evidence, counterclaim, gap or dispute and notify affected contexts.
effects: the challenged premise is not overwritten

functions.name: Validate or review assumption
functions.description: Apply a declared method and criteria, record contextual outcome and schedule follow-up.
effects: outcome never becomes a context-free truth flag

functions.name: Revise or supersede
functions.description: Create a correction, replacement, split or merge without overwriting prior reliance history.
effects: prior states and dependent uses remain resolvable

functions.name: Project assumption view
functions.description: Produce a minimum-necessary standards-aligned view with declared transformation loss.
effects: projection is logged and source identity preserved

Publish assumption-kind, epistemic-state, confidence, uncertainty, impact, validation-outcome, access, retention and interoperability registries.
Pin domain, assurance, risk, legal, safety, security, jurisdiction, analytical-method and exchange profiles.
dimension.namespace_guidance: Mint assumption, revision, assessment, challenge, acceptance and projection identifiers only in the adopting Dimension namespace; preserve proposition, fact, evidence, requirement, risk, decision, plan, test and source-document identities as typed external references.
registry_links: Dimension-local assumption, authority, uncertainty, validation, access, retention and provenance registries

canonicalization_rules: Canonicalize by registry ID, model version, authoritative assumption identity, proposition reference, immutable revision, intended-use context, owner and source; never use title, statement, date, filename or hash alone as identity.
Keep proposition content, assumption role, acceptance, evidence assessment, hypothesis, requirement, risk, decision, plan and validation outcome distinct.
patch_rules: Additive extensions use a Dimension-owned namespace and declare target node, profile, authority, source, rationale, access, time, dependency and interoperability impact.
Breaking changes require a new version, migration and crosswalk maps, compatibility declaration and continued resolution of prior revisions and dependent uses.
compatibility_rules: Consumers may ignore unknown additive fields only when identity, proposition, status, purpose, scope, authority, dependency, validation and access meaning remain intact.
SACM, SysML, ISO, NIST, NASA, Aqua Book, GAO, PROV, DQV, RO-Crate and DMN mappings pin source and target versions and declare transformed, omitted or non-round-trippable values.

identity_priority: Authoritative master-system identifier for the assumption and immutable revision, including an assumption-log identifier where that log is authoritative.
Governed globally resolvable assumption or proposition IRI.
Adopting-Dimension UUID or ULID when no authoritative external identifier exists.
artifact_rules.timestamp_rule: Record event timestamps in RFC 3339 with seconds and an explicit UTC offset or Z; keep proposal, acceptance, effective, observation, challenge, review, invalidation, expiry, correction and ingestion times distinct.
artifact_rules.serial_naming_rule: Name serial artifacts as {assumption-id}--{artifact-kind}--{revision-or-assessment-id}; never use a date, title, statement, result, filename or hash alone as identity.
artifact_rules.integrity_rule: Store digest, media type, byte length, issuer, source and vocabulary versions, purpose and scope, clocks, provenance, confidence, license and access marking for each retained serial artifact.

policies: The adopting Dimension declares who may propose, own, accept, challenge, validate, revise, disclose, retain and tombstone assumptions.
Every accepted assumption requires identity and revision, proposition, kind, purpose, scope, owner, authority, rationale, status, review trigger and false-consequence assessment as applicable.
Agents never infer truth, certainty, probability, safety, compliance or accountable approval from acceptance, confidence or one validation result.
Facts, evidence, hypotheses, requirements, risks, decisions, plans, tests and source documents remain external masters.

Automated agents may append low-risk classifications, links, freshness checks and projections under delegation, but acceptance, risk acceptance, protected disclosure and irreversible deletion require accountable authority.

read: Resolve active Dimension, purpose, role, requested revision, intended-use context, status, validity horizon, dependency depth, assurance, license and access policy; return the minimum permitted projection.
create: Create stable identity, proposition reference or marked statement, kind, proposer, owner, purpose, scope, rationale, review trigger and explicit unknowns before acceptance.
update: Append an immutable acceptance, context, evidence, challenge, assessment, consequence, dependency or correction revision with actor, authority, reason, RFC 3339 effective time and predecessor.
delete: Apply safety, legal, policy, dispute, audit, retention and legal-hold rules; tombstone eligible Assumption-owned records or withdraw projections while preserving identity, material provenance and non-cascading external references.

roles.name: Dimension owner
responsibilities: Own namespace, mastership, delegation, access, retention and federation rules.

roles.name: Assumption steward
responsibilities: Own assumption identity, kinds, states, review cadence, version and crosswalk policy.

roles.name: Proposer or analyst
responsibilities: Own statement, purpose, scope, rationale, uncertainty and dependency proposal.

roles.name: Owner or accountable user
responsibilities: Own operational reliance, monitoring, consequences, mitigation and escalation.

roles.name: Approver
responsibilities: Own bounded acceptance or rejection and sign-off rationale.

roles.name: Validator or reviewer
responsibilities: Own method, criteria, evidence, assessment and follow-up recommendation.

roles.name: Challenger or affected party
responsibilities: Append contrary evidence, impacts, disputes and correction requests without rewriting originals.

roles.name: Records and access steward
responsibilities: Own disclosure, retention, legal hold, tombstone and audit policy.

access.default_rule: Deny mutation and sensitive disclosure unless active Dimension, role, purpose, assumption sensitivity, dependent-output impact, jurisdiction, license and field policy grant the action; expose the minimum necessary projection.
exceptions: Emergency or legally compelled access must be grounded, time-limited, purpose-bound, attributable, independently reviewed and unable to erase immutable assumption, challenge, assessment, reliance or legal-hold evidence.
audit_requirements: Log actor, role, purpose, assumption and revision identity, action, decision, policy and vocabulary versions, RFC 3339 timestamp with offset, affected contexts, source evidence and outcome for privileged mutation or disclosure.

read_order: Read the nearest Dimension-owner AGENTS.md, active purpose, relying contexts, authorities, policy, jurisdiction, time, access, retention and licensing rules.
Read this model AGENTS.md, pinned spec.yaml and required claim, evidence, risk, decision, plan and validation instructions before mutation.

coverage.claim: Source-grounded reviewable draft covering Assumption identity, proposition role, expression, kind, epistemic status, purpose, actors, authority, scope, rationale, evidence, uncertainty, dependencies, consequences, validation, lifecycle, governance and interoperability.

checklist.notes: Assumption, proposition, revision, acceptance, challenge, assessment and successor identities remain distinct.
Planning, modeling, estimating, argument, safety and operational assumption profiles are explicit.
Statement, kind, status, purpose, scope, rationale, uncertainty, impact and review properties are covered.
Agents recognize assumptions by explicit premise role, declared reliance context and non-factual status rather than wording alone.
Draft, accepted, active, challenged, invalidated, expired, superseded and retired states preserve history.
Claims, evidence, requirements, risks, decisions, plans, tests and dependent outputs use typed references.
Proposal, acceptance, validity, observation, review, challenge, invalidation, expiry and correction clocks remain distinct.
Jurisdiction, environment, deployment setting, population and location scope are represented where relevant.
Proposer, source, rationale, evidence, acceptance, challenge, validation, reliance and revision are linked.
Proposition authorship, assumption ownership, acceptance authority, validation authority and decision accountability are not conflated.
Identity, context, authority, evidence, uncertainty, sensitivity, consequence, dependency, freshness and crosswalk checks are explicit.
Role, purpose, sensitivity, affected-output impact, minimum projection and audit are represented.
Challenges, assessments, reliance, corrections, audit or legal hold, withdrawal and tombstones are non-cascading.
Assurance, systems, risk, analysis, provenance, quality, packaging and decision mappings disclose loss.
Registration, classification, contextualization, acceptance, linking, assessment, challenge, validation, revision and projection declare controlled effects.

known_omissions: Discipline, safety, legal, policy, security, privacy, jurisdiction, analytical-method, licensing and retention profiles require expert review.
Propositions, facts, evidence, hypotheses, requirements, risks, decisions, plans, tests and source-document lifecycles remain neighboring masters.
Universal truth determination, automated risk acceptance, autonomous decision replacement and irreversible enforcement remain future work.
conflicts: SACM models an assumption as a claim declaration, while engineering and analytical logs often treat it as a separately governed register entry; the draft preserves both proposition and premise-role identities.
Accepted, supported, validated, confirmed and true are not interchangeable and require purpose-qualified semantics.
Confidence, probability, uncertainty, reliability, sensitivity, materiality and risk use different scales and cannot share one universal value.
regional_assumptions: ISO, OMG, NIST, NASA, UK and US government sources are profiles rather than universal organizational or legal rules.
Authority, sign-off, retention, disclosure, safety and consequences depend on organization, domain and jurisdiction.
Aqua Book and GAO guidance are strong analytical profiles but do not govern all scientific, engineering, legal or operational assumptions.
adversarial_checks: Reject an assumption without stable identity, proposition or marked statement, revision, kind, purpose, scope, owner, source and status.
Reject acceptance, confidence or one validation outcome represented as universal truth.
Reject missing or contrary evidence silently converted into support.
Reject downstream decisions, plans, risks, requirements or tests copied into the assumption instead of typed references.
Reject false-consequence or sensitivity claims without method, units, context, source and uncertainty.
Reject expired, invalidated or superseded assumptions silently deleted while dependent uses remain.
Reject acceptance, risk acceptance, protected disclosure or destruction outside delegated authority.
